positiveFlows.title: DECARBONIZING THE 260 MMT CO2/ YEAR STEAM CRACKING INDUSTRY THAT MAKES ETHYLENE AND BUTADIENE BY-PRODUCT IS NECESSARY TO ACHIEVE NET-ZERO EMISSION BY 2050. BUTADIENE A KEY PRECURSOR OF TIRES IS LARGELY CONSUMED BY BRIDGESTONE WHICH AIMS TO USE 100% SUSTAINABLE MATERIALS BY 2050. AS PART OF THIS GOAL BRIDGESTONE IS WORKING TO DEVELOP A FIRST-OF-KIND END-OF-LIFE RECYCLING PROCESS FOR TIRE MATERIAL CIRCULARITY AND THE DECARBONIZATION OF NEW TIRE PRODUCTION. THE OBJECTIVE IS TO CONDUCT PILOT SCALE DEMONSTRATION FOR EXTENDED TIME ON STREAM WITH THE GOAL OF COMMERCIAL DEPLOYMENT. THIS INCLUDES DEVELOPMENT OF ENGINEERED CATALYSTS AND THEIR EVALUATION UNDER INDUSTRIALLY RELEVANT CONDITIONS COUPLED WITH TECHNOECONOMIC ANALYSIS AND LIFE CYCLE ASSESSMENT AS WELL AS DESIGN, DEPLOYMENT, AND OPERATION OF THE PROCESS AT PILOT SCALE.

IEDO SEEKS TO LAUNCH A WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT CONSORTIUM THAT WILL CONVENE AND FINANCIALLY SUPPORT MANUFACTURING WORKFORCE ORGANIZATIONS THAT HAVE EXISTING REGIONAL AND/OR INDUSTRY-SPECIFIC NETWORKS AND REACH. CONSORTIUM MEMBERS WILL USE FUNDING TO DEVELOP, EXPAND, AND/OR SCALE SUCCESSFUL AND INNOVATIVE EDUCATION AND WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMS, EMBEDDING ENERGY EFFICIENCY AND DECARBONIZATION INTO INDUSTRY-FOCUSED TRAINING PROGRAMS. THE WORKFORCE CONSORTIUM WILL ALSO INCLUDE A FOCUS ON EXPANDING TRAINING IN DISADVANTAGED COMMUNITIES (DACS). CONSORTIUM MEMBERS WILL GET SUPPORT FROM A NATIONAL LABORATORY TEAM WHO HELPS CONVENE STAKEHOLDERS AND PROVIDE TECHNICAL EXPERTISE.

THE GOAL OF THIS PROJECT IS TO DEVELOP A DUAL-RECYCLE CARBON DIOXIDE (CO2) CONVERSION PLATFORM TAILORED FOR THE EXCLUSIVE CONVERSION OF CO2 INTO ETHYLENE (C2H4). THIS PROJECT IS FOCUSED ON ACHIEVING HIGH CARBON EFFICIENCY, ENERGY EFFICIENCY, C2H4 SELECTIVITY AND PRODUCTIVITY, AND LONG-TERM STABILITY. THE CO2 ELECTROLYZER WILL INTEGRATE CO2-TO-C2H4 CONVERSION AND THE DOWNSTREAM GAS SEPARATION UNIT WILL EFFECTIVELY SEPARATE THE REGENERATED AND UNREACTED CO2, ENABLING CO2 RECYCLING AND ENSURING A THEORETICAL CARBON EFFICIENCY OF 100%. DEVELOPMENT OF A DUAL-RECYCLE CO2 CONVERSION SYSTEM, ANION EXCHANGE MEMBRANE, C2H4-SELECTIVE CU CATALYST AND CATHODE, AND EXTENDED SURFACE ANODE WILL BE IMPLEMENTED TO ACHIEVE CO2 ELECTROLYSIS WITH INDUSTRIALLY RELEVANT PERFORMANCE METRICS. THE SUCCESS OF THE PROJECT WILL MARK THE FIRST-EVER DEMONSTRATION OF A CO2-TO-C2H4 CONVERSION PLATFORM CAPABLE OF PRODUCING C2H4 AS THE SOLE PRODUCT WITH A PURITY LEVEL OF 99.9%. THIS ACHIEVEMENT WOULD BE A SIGNIFICANT MILESTONE IN THE FIELD OF SUSTAINABLE CO2 UTILIZATION.
